title: Choir and Sigil
author: Hazel Joubert
blurb: Marguerite Underhill, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
